title: SAMPLE: Captions for voice chat
items: SAMPLE ENTRY for testing only. Real news comes from the game.
Turn on Show captions in Settings to see what people say on voice chat, in big easy-to-read text.
Captions only appear if the speaker chose to share them. Nothing is saved in the chat.

title: SAMPLE: No more frozen tables
items: If a phone falls asleep mid-game, the table keeps going when the turn timer runs out.
Lost your signal? Your game now waits 20 minutes for you to come back.

title: SAMPLE: The bots talk back now
items: SAMPLE ENTRY for testing only. The tags in this title should show as plain text, not bold.
Bots tease you by name when you hit them, draw big, or forget to call Last Card.
Not into it? Turn off Bot banter in Settings.
